trace.question: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format.
trace.evidence: mythic rarity printing refers to rarity = 'mythic'; card banned refers to status = 'Banned'; in gladiator format refers to format = 'gladiator';

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'
trace.answer: The mythic rarity cards banned in the Gladiator format are Oko, Thief of Crowns and Nexus of Fate.
